principles.name: Keep the Word distinct, and teach it truly
principles.question: Can a reader always tell Scripture from our words, and our words from a machine’s?

principles.name: Never speak for God
principles.question: Would we put our own name under this sentence, or are we borrowing God’s?

principles.name: Design for the most vulnerable first
principles.question: Who is the most vulnerable person likely to use this today, and what will they see?

principles.name: Welcome before you ask, and guard what is told in confidence
principles.question: If a friend read everything we keep about this person, would the person be glad?

principles.name: Feed the flock, not on it
principles.question: Does this serve growth in faith, or only the usage numbers?

principles.name: Make room for rest, and say when it is enough
principles.question: Where does our product stop, and does it ever tell someone they have done enough?

principles.name: Send people to God and to one another
principles.question: When someone closes what we built, are they closer to God and to other people?

principles.name: Plant and water; leave the growth to God
principles.question: What would we stop measuring if we believed growth is God’s?

principles.name: Make it well, as an offering
principles.question: Would we offer this to God as it is, and could the person with the least sight, time or reading ease use it?

principles.name: Hold it with joy and trembling, before God and others
principles.question: Who outside the team holds us to account, and who prays for the people who use this?

frame.label: Concern
frame.description: Actual coercion, deception or extraction must be evidenced in the feature or flow; do not infer malicious intent.

frame.label: Ethical baseline
frame.description: Respect agency, truth and dignity through clear roles, meaningful choice and appropriate safeguards in the assessed interaction.

frame.label: Redemptive possibility
frame.description: Requires a concrete loss or exclusion addressed, a restorative mechanism, cost or risk freely borne by the builder, and benefit or a credible mechanism for people served. Candidates are not awards.
